label: 建筑生成
description: 完整建筑生成管线：对单张区域掩码依次执行建筑雕刻、外墙轮廓提取、BSP内墙生成、外门/内门开凿、开窗、室内地面按房间拆分，输出含墙顶/外墙体/内墙体/窗户/室内地面的单张多值网格、名称清单及大门网格。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
description-en: Full building generation pipeline on a single mask: carving, wall outline, BSP inner walls, outer/inner doors, windows, and indoor floor splitting by room. Outputs one multi-value grid (roof-top/outer-body/inner-body/window/per-room floors), a name list, and a door grid. Grid lists are handled per-item by the DataTree engine.
icon: 扁平插画风格小图标。俯视建筑平面图，白色/浅灰背景，深色外墙轮廓勾勒矩形建筑，内部有细线内墙分隔成多个房间，墙上有小缺口表示门和窗，整体构图简洁，主色深灰与浅蓝，突出「建筑平面」的设计感。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 建筑区域
inputs.description: 单张建筑地块掩码网格（每非零单元格视为建筑可用区域）；网格列表由引擎逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: Single building plot mask grid (non-zero cells treated as valid building area). The engine fans out a grid list one-by-one.

inputs.name: wallThickness
inputs.label: 外墙厚度
inputs.description: 外墙轮廓的向内厚度（格数），最小值1
inputs.description-en: Inward thickness of the outer wall outline in cells (minimum 1).

inputs.name: innerWallDensity
inputs.label: 内墙密度
inputs.description: BSP内墙的密度，0=无内墙，1=最大分割深度（6层），值域[0,1]
inputs.description-en: BSP inner wall density: 0 = no inner walls, 1 = maximum split depth (6 levels). Range [0, 1].

inputs.name: doorCount
inputs.label: 外门数量
inputs.description: 每栋建筑的外门（大门）数量，0表示不开外门
inputs.description-en: Number of outer doors (main entrances) per building. 0 = no outer doors.

inputs.name: doorWidth
inputs.label: 外门宽度
inputs.description: 外门的格宽（格数），最小值1
inputs.description-en: Width of outer doors in cells (minimum 1).

inputs.name: windowCount
inputs.label: 窗户数量
inputs.description: 每栋建筑的窗户数量（内外两侧均为空格的外墙格才能开窗），0表示不开窗
inputs.description-en: Number of windows per building (only outer wall cells with empty neighbors on both sides qualify). 0 = no windows.

inputs.name: windowWidth
inputs.label: 窗户宽度
inputs.description: 窗户的格宽（格数），最小值1

inputs.name: buildingHeight
inputs.label: 建筑高度
inputs.description: 建筑的格高（H）。大于0时，将外墙与窗户合并后整体向上平移H行，作为墙顶层额外输出；0表示不生成墙顶
inputs.description-en: Building height in cells (H). When > 0, the combined outer-wall + window mask is shifted upward by H rows and output as a "墙顶" (wall-top) layer. 0 = no wall-top output.

inputs.name: windowRandom
inputs.label: 窗户随机布局
inputs.description: 开启后窗户随机分布；关闭后均匀分布在墙体上
inputs.description-en: When enabled, windows are placed randomly. When disabled, they are distributed evenly along the wall.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 随机种子，0 使用当前时间戳

inputs.name: mergeOutput
inputs.label: 地板合并
inputs.description: 开启后将该建筑所有房间地面合并为一张地板层（id=5）；关闭后每个房间各占一个递增 id（5,6,7…）
inputs.description-en: When enabled, all rooms of this building share one floor layer (id=5). When disabled, each room gets its own ascending id (5,6,7…).

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 建筑网格
outputs.description: 单张多值网格：墙顶=1，外墙体=2，内墙体=3，窗户=4，室内地面从5起（合并时地板=5，否则每房间递增id）。重叠按 地板→内墙体→外墙体→窗户→墙顶 后写覆盖；可接 grid_split_by_value 拆层。
outputs.description-en: Single multi-value grid: roof-top=1, outer-body=2, inner-body=3, window=4, floors from 5. Overlaps written floor→inner-body→outer-body→window→roof-top (later wins); pipe to grid_split_by_value to separate layers.

outputs.name: outputNameList
outputs.label: 建筑名称清单
outputs.description: 名称清单，仅含实际出现的 id，格式 [{id, name, type}]；地板条目按房间，墙体打包条目 id=[3,2,4,1] 名称「墙体」。
outputs.description-en: Name list with only ids actually present, format [{id, name, type}]; floor entries per room, wall pack entry id=[3,2,4,1] named "墙体".

outputs.name: doorGrid
outputs.label: 大门
outputs.description: 该建筑大门（外门）单张网格，大门格值为1，其余为0
outputs.description-en: Single grid of this building's outer doors; door cells = 1, everything else = 0.
